name: Medium coastal fish
description: Medium-sized coastal fishes of the Banc and the near shore - drums, threadfins, pomadasyids and similar species (33 in the source's list), grazing the Banc's benthos: worms, molluscs, algae and eelgrass. Functional group pooling the source's single 'Coastal M' compartment, a size-and-habitat guild measured together by the source.
